lines.text: الباقي من المسطرة على قَدْر تلك الاقسام على حَسَب ما نُريد من القِلّة والكَثْرة الى تَمام وَتَر خمسة
lines.plain: الباقي من المسطرة على قَدْر تلك الاقسام على حَسَب ما نُريد من القِلّة والكَثْرة الى تَمام وَتَر خمسة

lines.text: واربعين جزءًا المُنَصَّف ليكون اكثر ما تبلُغ اقسام خطّ {ov:ط م} اثنَيْن واربعين جزءًا ونصْفًا بالتقريب وما
lines.plain: واربعين جزءًا المُنَصَّف ليكون اكثر ما تبلُغ اقسام خطّ ط م اثنَيْن واربعين جزءًا ونصْفًا بالتقريب وما

lines.text: بَقِيَ من المِسْطَرة حَذَقْناه ثمّ نثقُب مسطرتَيْ {ov:ز ط} و{ov:ط م} على نقطة {ov:ط} ثَقْبَيْن مُسْتَدِيرَيْن كما ثقَبْنا
lines.plain: بَقِيَ من المِسْطَرة حَذَقْناه ثمّ نثقُب مسطرتَيْ ز ط وط م على نقطة ط ثَقْبَيْن مُسْتَدِيرَيْن كما ثقَبْنا

lines.text: الاوّلَيْن وننظِمهما بقُطْب ونشُدّه كما ننظِم قُطْب الأَسْطُرْلاب لنحرِّك مِسْطرة {ov:ط م} حيْث شِئْنا من الشَّمال
lines.plain: الاوّلَيْن وننظِمهما بقُطْب ونشُدّه كما ننظِم قُطْب الأَسْطُرْلاب لنحرِّك مِسْطرة ط م حيْث شِئْنا من الشَّمال

lines.text: والجَنوب ولا تقلَق ولا تضطرِب ونفرِض في مسطرة {ov:ط م} من خطّ {ov:ط م} فَرْضًا في نصف عَرْضها ونِصْفها{mR:5}
lines.plain: والجَنوب ولا تقلَق ولا تضطرِب ونفرِض في مسطرة ط م من خطّ ط م فَرْضًا في نصف عَرْضها ونِصْفها

lines.text: الأَعْلَى الخارج بقَدْر نصف غِلْظ المِسْطرة في كلّ الطول وكذلك نفرِض في طَرَف مسطرة {ov:ز ل} بقدر
lines.plain: الأَعْلَى الخارج بقَدْر نصف غِلْظ المِسْطرة في كلّ الطول وكذلك نفرِض في طَرَف مسطرة ز ل بقدر

lines.text: نصف غِلْظ مسطرة {ov:ط م} وعرضها ونحذِف اطراف تربيع مسطرة {ov:ز ل} من الجانِبَيْن قليلًا قليلًا *ليسهُل{mL:f. 147,v.}
lines.plain: نصف غِلْظ مسطرة ط م وعرضها ونحذِف اطراف تربيع مسطرة ز ل من الجانِبَيْن قليلًا قليلًا *ليسهُل

lines.text: ويسلَس مَدارها وحَرَكتها على خطّ {ov:ط م} ويقَع وَجْه المسطرتَيْن من قِبَل الفَرْض الذي قد فرَضنا
lines.plain: ويسلَس مَدارها وحَرَكتها على خطّ ط م ويقَع وَجْه المسطرتَيْن من قِبَل الفَرْض الذي قد فرَضنا

lines.text: سَطْحًا واحدًا لا يَعْلُو احدهما على الآخر ويَنْتُو عليه ثمّ نُدير عَمود {ov:ا ب ج د} الذي قد اثْبَتْنا فيه مِسْطرة
lines.plain: سَطْحًا واحدًا لا يَعْلُو احدهما على الآخر ويَنْتُو عليه ثمّ نُدير عَمود ا ب ج د الذي قد اثْبَتْنا فيه مِسْطرة

lines.text: {ov:ز ط ح} حتَّى يَقُوم على خطّ {ov:ب ج} من تربيعه على خطّ نصف النهار ويقَع خطّ الشَّاقول اذا أُرْسِل من{mR:10}
lines.plain: ز ط ح حتَّى يَقُوم على خطّ ب ج من تربيعه على خطّ نصف النهار ويقَع خطّ الشَّاقول اذا أُرْسِل من

lines.text: نقطة {ov:ز}{n:1} الى نقطة {ov:ط} ليكون قِيام المسطرة على زَوَايا قائمة ويكون وَجْه سَطْح المسطرة قائمًا على خطّ
lines.plain: نقطة ز الى نقطة ط ليكون قِيام المسطرة على زَوَايا قائمة ويكون وَجْه سَطْح المسطرة قائمًا على خطّ

lines.text: نصف النهار مَوْزونًا عليه مُواجِهًا للمشرِق وكذلك الشُّطْبَتانِ المركَّبتانِ في المِسْطَرة الثانية وكذلك
lines.plain: نصف النهار مَوْزونًا عليه مُواجِهًا للمشرِق وكذلك الشُّطْبَتانِ المركَّبتانِ في المِسْطَرة الثانية وكذلك

lines.text: الأقسام التي في مسطرة {ov:ط م} تُواجِه المشرِق وتكون مرسومة على طول نصف المسطرة الذي وقع الفَرْض
lines.plain: الأقسام التي في مسطرة ط م تُواجِه المشرِق وتكون مرسومة على طول نصف المسطرة الذي وقع الفَرْض

lines.text: في النصف الثاني منه فإِذا جازَتِ الشمس على خطّ نصف النهار حرّكنا المسطرة التي فيها الشُّطْبَتانِ
lines.plain: في النصف الثاني منه فإِذا جازَتِ الشمس على خطّ نصف النهار حرّكنا المسطرة التي فيها الشُّطْبَتانِ

lines.text: نحو الشَّمال والجَنوب حتَّى تُظِلّ الشُّطْبة العُلْيا [الشُّطْبة السُّفْلى]{n:2} كلّها وينفُذ شِعاع الشمس من ثَقْب{mR:15}
lines.plain: نحو الشَّمال والجَنوب حتَّى تُظِلّ الشُّطْبة العُلْيا [الشُّطْبة السُّفْلى] كلّها وينفُذ شِعاع الشمس من ثَقْب

lines.text: الشُّطْبة العُلْيا في ثَقْب الشطبة السُّفْلَى ونمُدّ مع ذلك مسطرة {ov:ط م} ونحرِّكها نحو الشمال والجنوب
lines.plain: الشُّطْبة العُلْيا في ثَقْب الشطبة السُّفْلَى ونمُدّ مع ذلك مسطرة ط م ونحرِّكها نحو الشمال والجنوب

lines.text: حتّى نُلْصِق خطّ {ov:ط م} الذي في عرض المسطرة المفروضة بنقطة {ov:ل} التي من مسطرة {ov:ز ل} من أَجْل
lines.plain: حتّى نُلْصِق خطّ ط م الذي في عرض المسطرة المفروضة بنقطة ل التي من مسطرة ز ل من أَجْل

lines.text: الفَرْضَيْن اللّذانِ فرَضْناهما ونعلَم على كمْ من العَدَد المقسوم في مسطرة {ov:ط م} وقعت نقطة {ov:ل} فنُدْخِل
lines.plain: الفَرْضَيْن اللّذانِ فرَضْناهما ونعلَم على كمْ من العَدَد المقسوم في مسطرة ط م وقعت نقطة ل فنُدْخِل

lines.text: ذلك الى جَدْوَل الاوتار المنصَّفة فنقوِّسه فما خرَجَتِ القَوْس اضْعَفْناها فما بلَغت فهو بُعْد الشمس عن
lines.plain: ذلك الى جَدْوَل الاوتار المنصَّفة فنقوِّسه فما خرَجَتِ القَوْس اضْعَفْناها فما بلَغت فهو بُعْد الشمس عن

lines.text: نُقْطة سَمْت الرُّؤُس اذا كان ابتداء عَدَد المسطرة من نقطة {ov:ط} وكذلك لو قسَمْنا خطّ {ov:ط ك} بستّين{mR:20}
lines.plain: نُقْطة سَمْت الرُّؤُس اذا كان ابتداء عَدَد المسطرة من نقطة ط وكذلك لو قسَمْنا خطّ ط ك بستّين

lines.text: جُزْءًا على قدر نصف *القُطْر وقسَمْنا خطّ {ov:ك م} الى تمام خمسة وثمانين جزءًا ثمّ اخَذْنا العَدَد الذي تقَع{mL:f. 148,r.}
lines.plain: جُزْءًا على قدر نصف *القُطْر وقسَمْنا خطّ ك م الى تمام خمسة وثمانين جزءًا ثمّ اخَذْنا العَدَد الذي تقَع

lines.text: عليه نقطة {ov:ل} فعرَفْنا نصفه فقَوَّسْناه وما بلَغَتِ القَوْس اضْعَفْناها. كان المَعْنَى واحد. والرَّصْد بهذه
lines.plain: عليه نقطة ل فعرَفْنا نصفه فقَوَّسْناه وما بلَغَتِ القَوْس اضْعَفْناها. كان المَعْنَى واحد. والرَّصْد بهذه

observations: L01, L03, L08, L10, L12, L15, L16, L17, L18, L19, L20, L21, L22: long joins (تَمـام on L01; مـن and نقطـة on L03; قِبَـل and قـد on L08; مـن at the end of L10; عليـه and الثانيـة on L12; وينفُـذ on L15; نحـو on L16; the first مـن and, at the end of the line, أَجْـل on L17; فنُدْخِـل at the end of L18; the first فمـا on L19; ابتـداء and عَـدَد on L20; تقَـع at the end of L21; ومـا, واحـد and, at the end of the line, بهـذه on L22). The kāf of وحَرَكتها on L08, of حرّكنا on L14 and of ونحرِّكها on L16 is the long kāf; on L16 its upper stroke stands free of the letter (4.7 x 3.2 pt).

The page continues chapter 57: twenty-two lines of text that fill the page, a rule, one line of notes and the signature of the sheet. The lines run the full measure (L01 from 125.5 to 546.0 pt, L22 from 126.9 to 551.0 pt: the block leans a little); the baselines stand from 131.4 to 689.8 pt down. Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the right margin beside L05, L10, L15 and L20 (554.0 to 565.6 pt). The folio numbers stand in the left margin: «f. 147,v.» beside L07 (88.2 to 119.2 pt), where the asterisk (4.7 x 5.4 pt) stands before ليسهُل, and «f. 148,r.» beside L21 (91.1 to 119.9 pt), where the asterisk (5.0 x 5.4 pt) stands before القُطْر. Full stops stand on L22 after اضْعَفْناها and after واحد.
Nallino's corrigenda name one place of this page: «٢١٧,18, اللذَيْن». The print has اللّذانِ on L18, with a shadda over the second lām and a kasra under the nūn; it is kept as printed.

The barred letters, each group under one bar: ط م on L02; ز ط, ط م and ط on L03 (the wāw before ط م stands outside its bar); ط م on L04; ط م twice on L05; ز ل on L06; ط م and ز ل on L07; ط م on L08; ا ب ج د on L09 (a bar of 28.9 pt); ز ط ح at the head of L10 (23.4 pt) and ب ج on the same line; ز and ط on L11; ط م on L13 and L16; ط م, ل and ز ل on L17; ط م and ل on L18; ط and ط ك on L20; ك م on L21; ل on L22. In the master scan the bar over ط on L20 is in two pieces (5.8 and 4.3 pt); the second copy has it whole. The square brackets on L15 enclose الشُّطْبة السُّفْلى (the opening one at 355.0 pt, 2.5 x 16.9 pt; the closing one at 290.5 pt, 2.2 x 16.9 pt), with the note figure 2 after the closing bracket. The page has no numerals. The note figures: 1 after the barred ز on L11 (2.9 x 6.8 pt) and 2 on L15 (4.0 x 5.8 pt). The rule stands from 127.8 to 228.2 pt (100.4 pt long) at 717.5 pt down. The notes are one line (baseline 744.8 pt, from 154.8 to 280.6 pt), with a dash between the two notes; note 1 has the letter د, without a sign. The signature «28» stands at the foot (511.6 to 520.2 pt, 8.6 x 6.5 pt, its foot 765.0 pt down); a small mark right of it (535.3 to 537.5 pt, 2.2 x 4.0 pt) is no part of it.

In مُسْتَدِيرَيْن on L03 (both yā') and نُدير on L09 the two dots of the yā' stand under the tooth, joined to the foot of the letter. In ونحذِف on L07, نحو on L15 and L16, لنحرِّك on L04 and ونحرِّكها on L16 the nūn is a small tooth over the ḥā' with its dot above it; in نحـو on L16 the dot is joined to the tooth. The dot of the khā' of الخارج on L06 touches the letter. The rā' of المِسْطرة on L06 is printed in two pieces, a dot on the line and a small stroke under it, in both copies; the word has no kasra there. The alif of فإِذا on L14 is thin and short (1.1 x 4.0 pt) in both copies. The three dots of the shīn of الشمس on L14, L15 and L19 stand high (11 pt above the baseline). The round sukun is mostly printed solid in the master where the second copy shows a ring; over the rā' of الأَسْطُرْلاب on L04 it is a ring in the master too.

Marks of the master scan that the second copy does not have, and that are not transcribed: over the lām of السُّفْلى on L15 a short stroke and a speck (1.4 x 1.1 and 0.7 pt), where السُّفْلَى on L16 has its fatha; a speck under the damma of المُنَصَّف on L02 (0.7 pt).

L01: قَدْر: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.9 pt). حَسَب: a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the sīn (3.2 x 2.2 pt). نُريد: a damma over the dot of the nūn (2.5 x 4.7 pt). القِلّة: a kasra under the qāf (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a shadda over the second lām (3.2 x 2.5 pt). والكَثْرة: a fatha over the kāf (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the three dots of the thā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). تَمام: a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). وَتَر: a fatha over the wāw (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt). الباقي, من (twice), المسطرة, على (twice), تلك, الاقسام, ما, الى and خمسة have no signs.

L02: جزءًا (twice): the fathatan over the hamza, the two run together into one blot (the first 4.0 x 5.8 pt); no other sign. المُنَصَّف: a damma high over the lām, 18 pt above the baseline (2.2 x 2.9 pt), a fatha over the dot of the nūn (3.6 x 1.8 pt), and over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt). تبلُغ: a damma over the lām (2.2 x 3.6 pt). خطّ: a shadda (3.2 x 2.2 pt). اثنَيْن: a fatha over the dot of the nūn (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). ونصْفًا: a round sukun over the ṣād (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and the fathatan (4.0 x 3.2 pt). واربعين (twice), ليكون, اكثر, ما, اقسام, بالتقريب and وما have no signs.

L03: بَقِيَ: a fatha over the bā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a kasra under the qāf (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the yā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), whose two dots stand under it in one piece (2.9 x 1.8 pt). المِسْطَرة: a kasra under the mīm (2.9 x 1.4 pt), a round sukun over the sīn (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the ṭā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt). حَذَقْناه: a fatha over the ḥā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the dot of the dhāl (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun (2.5 x 2.9 pt) over the next letter, which is printed with two dots, a qāf (the dots joined in the master, 2.9 x 1.8 pt, and apart in the second copy), where حَذَفْناه is expected; the dot of the nūn stands beside them (2.2 x 2.2 pt). ثمّ: a shadda (3.2 x 2.2 pt). نثقُب: a damma over the dots of the thā' and the qāf, which run together. مسطرتَيْ: a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). ثَقْبَيْن: a fatha over the three dots of the thā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf (2.2 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the bā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.2 pt). مُسْتَدِيرَيْن: a damma over the mīm (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the sīn (2.2 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt), a kasra under the dāl (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a round sukun over the second yā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt). ثقَبْنا: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). من, على, نقطة and كما have no signs.

L04: الاوّلَيْن: a shadda over the wāw (3.2 x 2.2 pt), without a vowel, a fatha over the lām (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt); the alif has no hamza. وننظِمهما: a small kasra under the ẓā' (2.2 x 1.4 pt). بقُطْب: a damma over the two dots of the qāf (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). ونشُدّه: a damma over the three dots of the shīn (2.5 x 4.3 pt) and a shadda over the dāl (3.2 x 1.8 pt). ننظِم: a small kasra under the ẓā' (2.2 x 1.1 pt). قُطْب: a damma over the two dots of the qāf (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). الأَسْطُرْلاب: over the alif a hamza with a fatha above it (3.2 x 4.7 pt together), a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a damma over the ṭā', joined to the top of its stem in the master and a hair apart in the second copy, and a sukun over the rā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt). لنحرِّك: over the rā' a shadda (3.2 x 2.2 pt) with a kasra under the letter (3.2 x 2.2 pt). مِسْطرة: a kasra under the mīm (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt); no sign over the ṭā'. حيْث: a round sukun over the yā' (2.2 x 2.2 pt). شِئْنا: a kasra under the shīn (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and over its tooth a hamza with a sukun above it (3.2 x 5.8 pt together). الشَّمال: over the three dots of the shīn a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). كما and من have no signs.

L05: والجَنوب: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 1.8 pt). تقلَق: a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.2 pt). تضطرِب: a kasra under the rā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt). ونفرِض: a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt). خطّ: a shadda (2.9 x 2.5 pt). فَرْضًا: a fatha over the dot of the fā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt), a round sukun over the rā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and the fathatan (3.6 x 2.9 pt). عَرْضها: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). ونِصْفها: a kasra under the nūn (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and over the ṣād a sukun printed flat (2.9 x 1.8 pt). ولا (twice), في (twice), مسطرة, من and نصف have no signs.

L06: الأَعْلَى: over the alif a hamza with a fatha above it (2.9 x 4.3 pt together), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 1.8 pt). بقَدْر: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.5 pt). غِلْظ: a kasra under the ghayn (2.9 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the lām (2.2 x 2.5 pt). المِسْطرة: a kasra under the mīm (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the sīn (2.2 x 2.5 pt); no sign over the ṭā'. كلّ: a shadda (2.9 x 2.2 pt). نفرِض: a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). طَرَف: a fatha over the ṭā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). الخارج, نصف, في (twice), الطول, وكذلك, مسطرة and بقدر have no signs.

L07: غِلْظ: a kasra under the ghayn (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the lām (2.5 x 2.5 pt). ونحذِف: a kasra under the dhāl (3.6 x 1.8 pt). الجانِبَيْن: a kasra under the nūn (3.2 x 1.8 pt), and a fatha over the bā' and a sukun over the yā', which run together. قليلًا (twice): the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 and 3.6 x 2.9 pt). ليسهُل: a damma over the hā' (2.5 x 4.3 pt). نصف, مسطرة (twice), وعرضها, اطراف, تربيع and من have no signs.

L08: ويسلَس: a small fatha over the lām (2.5 x 1.8 pt). مَدارها: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.5 pt). وحَرَكتها: a fatha over the ḥā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt). خطّ: a shadda (3.2 x 2.5 pt). ويقَع: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt). وَجْه: a fatha over the wāw (3.6 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the jīm (2.5 x 2.5 pt). المسطرتَيْن: a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.2 x 2.2 pt). قِبَل: a kasra under the qāf (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the bā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt). الفَرْض: a fatha over the dot of the fā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). فرَضنا: a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt); no sign over the ḍād. على, من, الذي and قد have no signs.

L09: سَطْحًا: a fatha over the sīn (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and the fathatan, joined to the top of the alif. واحدًا: the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt). يَعْلُو: a fatha over the yā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a damma over the lām (2.5 x 4.7 pt). الآخر: the madda over the alif. ويَنْتُو: a fatha over the yā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the nūn (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and a damma over the two dots of the tā' (2.2 x 4.3 pt). ثمّ: a shadda (3.2 x 2.2 pt). نُدير: a damma over the dot of the nūn (2.5 x 5.0 pt). عَمود: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.2 pt). اثْبَتْنا: a round sukun over the three dots of the thā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the bā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the two dots of the tā' (2.2 x 2.9 pt). مِسْطرة: a kasra under the mīm (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.5 pt). لا, احدهما, على, عليه, الذي, قد and فيه have no signs.

L10: حتَّى: over the two dots of the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). يَقُوم: a fatha over the yā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and a damma over the two dots of the qāf (2.5 x 4.7 pt). خطّ (three times): a shadda (3.6 x 2.5, 3.2 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 2.5 pt). ويقَع: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt). الشَّاقول: over the three dots of the shīn a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt). أُرْسِل: over the alif a hamza with a damma above it (3.2 x 5.8 pt together), a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the sīn (2.9 x 2.2 pt). على (twice), من (twice), تربيعه, نصف, النهار and اذا have no signs.

L11: قِيام: a small kasra under the qāf (2.5 x 1.4 pt). زَوَايا: a fatha over the dot of the zāy (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the wāw (2.9 x 1.8 pt). قائمة: a hamza over its tooth (2.9 x 2.9 pt). وَجْه: a fatha over the wāw (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the jīm (2.2 x 2.5 pt). سَطْح: a fatha over the sīn (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt). قائمًا: a hamza over its tooth (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and the fathatan (3.6 x 2.9 pt). خطّ: a shadda (3.2 x 2.5 pt). نقطة (twice), الى, ليكون, المسطرة (twice), على (twice) and ويكون have no signs.

L12: مَوْزونًا: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the wāw (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and the fathatan (3.6 x 2.9 pt). مُواجِهًا: a damma over the mīm (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a kasra under the jīm (2.5 x 1.8 pt) and the fathatan (3.2 x 3.2 pt). للمشرِق: a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt). الشُّطْبَتانِ: over the three dots of the shīn a shadda with a damma above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 2.5 x 4.0 pt), a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the bā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a kasra under the nūn (3.6 x 2.2 pt). المركَّبتانِ: over the kāf a shadda (3.2 x 1.8 pt) with a short fatha above it (1.4 x 1.1 pt, in both copies), and a kasra under the nūn (3.6 x 1.8 pt). المِسْطَرة: a kasra under the mīm (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the ṭā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt). نصف, النهار, عليه, وكذلك (twice), في and الثانية have no signs.

L13: الأقسام: a hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt), without a vowel. تُواجِه: a damma over the two dots of the tā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a kasra under the jīm (2.9 x 2.2 pt). المشرِق: a kasra under the rā' (3.2 x 1.4 pt). الفَرْض: a fatha over the dot of the fā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). التي, في, مسطرة, وتكون, مرسومة, على, طول, نصف, المسطرة, الذي and وقع have no signs.

L14: فإِذا: a hamza under the alif (2.5 x 2.5 pt) with a kasra under it (2.5 x 1.4 pt), clear in the master and faint in the second copy. جازَتِ: a fatha over the dot of the zāy (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the tā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt). خطّ: a shadda (3.2 x 2.5 pt). حرّكنا: a shadda over the rā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt), without a vowel. الشُّطْبَتانِ: over the three dots of the shīn a shadda with a damma above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 2.2 x 3.2 pt), a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the bā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the nūn (3.6 x 2.2 pt). في, النصف, الثاني, منه, الشمس, على, نصف, النهار, المسطرة, التي and فيها have no signs.

L15: الشَّمال: over the three dots of the shīn a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). والجَنوب: a fatha over the jīm (3.2 x 2.2 pt). حتَّى: over the two dots of the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.6 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt). تُظِلّ: a damma over the two dots of the tā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt), a kasra under the ẓā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a shadda over the lām (3.6 x 2.5 pt). الشُّطْبة: over the three dots of the shīn a shadda with a damma above it (2.9 x 2.2 and 1.8 x 4.0 pt) and a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.2 x 2.2 pt). العُلْيا: a damma over the ʿayn (2.2 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the lām (2.2 x 2.9 pt). The second الشُّطْبة, after the bracket: a shadda with a damma above it (3.2 x 6.1 pt together) and a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.2 x 2.2 pt). السُّفْلى: over the sīn a shadda with a damma above it (2.9 x 6.1 pt together) and a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.2 x 2.2 pt); no fatha over the lām. كلّها: a shadda (3.2 x 2.2 pt). وينفُذ: a damma over the dot of the fā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt). شِعاع: a kasra under the shīn (2.5 x 1.8 pt). ثَقْب: a fatha over the three dots of the thā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf (2.5 x 2.5 pt). نحو, الشمس and من have no signs.

L16: الشُّطْبة: over the three dots of the shīn a shadda with a damma above it (3.6 x 6.5 pt together) and a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt). العُلْيا: a damma over the ʿayn (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the lām (2.2 x 2.5 pt). ثَقْب: a fatha over the three dots of the thā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf (2.5 x 2.5 pt). السُّفْلَى: over the sīn a shadda with a damma above it (3.2 x 6.5 pt together), a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the lām (2.9 x 1.8 pt). ونمُدّ: a damma over the mīm (2.2 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the dāl (3.2 x 2.2 pt). ونحرِّكها: over the rā' a shadda (3.2 x 2.5 pt) with a kasra under the letter (3.2 x 1.8 pt). في, الشطبة, مع, ذلك, مسطرة, نحو, الشمال and والجنوب have no signs.

L17: حتّى: a shadda over the two dots of the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt), without a fatha. نُلْصِق: a damma over the dot of the nūn (2.2 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the lām (2.9 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the ṣād (3.2 x 1.8 pt). خطّ: a shadda (3.2 x 2.2 pt). أَجْل: over the alif a hamza with a fatha above it (3.2 x 4.7 pt together) and a round sukun over the jīm (2.2 x 2.5 pt). الذي, في, عرض, المسطرة, المفروضة, بنقطة, التي, من (twice) and مسطرة have no signs.

L18: الفَرْضَيْن: a fatha over the dot of the fā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a sukun over the rā' and a fatha over the ḍād, which run together in both copies, and a round sukun over the yā' (2.9 x 2.5 pt). اللّذانِ: a shadda over the second lām (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the nūn (3.6 x 1.8 pt). فرَضْناهما: a small fatha over the rā' (2.5 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the ḍād (2.5 x 2.5 pt). ونعلَم: a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 1.8 pt). كمْ: a sukun over the mīm (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a ring in the master; no sign over the kāf. العَدَد: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a small fatha over the first dāl (2.5 x 1.8 pt). فنُدْخِل: a damma over the dot of the nūn (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the dāl (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the khā' (2.5 x 1.8 pt). على, من, المقسوم, في, مسطرة, وقعت and نقطة have no signs.

L19: جَدْوَل: a fatha over the jīm (4.0 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the wāw (2.9 x 1.8 pt). المنصَّفة: over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). فنقوِّسه: over the wāw a shadda (3.2 x 2.5 pt) with a kasra under the letter (3.2 x 1.8 pt). خرَجَتِ: a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt), a fatha over the jīm (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the tā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt). القَوْس: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the wāw (2.2 x 2.5 pt). اضْعَفْناها: a round sukun over the dot of the ḍād (2.5 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the ʿayn (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt). بلَغت: a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.2 pt). بُعْد: a damma over the bā' (2.2 x 5.0 pt) and a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.5 pt). ذلك, الى, الاوتار, فما (twice), فهو, الشمس and عن have no signs.

L20: نُقْطة: a damma over the dot of the nūn (2.2 x 4.0 pt) and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf (2.5 x 2.5 pt). سَمْت: a fatha over the sīn (4.0 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the mīm (2.5 x 2.5 pt). الرُّؤُس: over the rā' a shadda with a damma above it (3.2 x 6.1 pt together) and over the wāw a hamza with a damma above it (3.6 x 6.1 pt together). عَدَد: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the first dāl (3.6 x 2.2 pt). قسَمْنا: a fatha over the sīn (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the mīm (2.2 x 2.5 pt). خطّ: a shadda (3.2 x 2.2 pt). بستّين: a shadda over the two dots of the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt). اذا, كان, ابتداء, المسطرة, من, نقطة, وكذلك and لو have no signs.

L21: جُزْءًا: a damma over the jīm (2.2 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the zāy (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and the fathatan over the hamza, the two run together; the second جزءًا has the fathatan alone. القُطْر: a damma over the two dots of the qāf (2.2 x 4.3 pt) and a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.2 x 2.2 pt). وقسَمْنا: a small fatha over the sīn (2.5 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the mīm (2.5 x 2.5 pt). خطّ: a shadda (2.9 x 2.2 pt). ثمّ: a shadda (3.2 x 2.5 pt). اخَذْنا: a fatha over the dot of the khā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the dhāl (2.2 x 2.5 pt). العَدَد: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the first dāl (3.6 x 2.5 pt). تقَع: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.2 x 1.8 pt). على, قدر, نصف, الى, تمام, خمسة, وثمانين and الذي have no signs.

L22: فعرَفْنا: a fatha over the rā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt). فقَوَّسْناه: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.2 x 2.2 pt), over the wāw a shadda with a fatha above it (2.9 x 2.2 and 2.9 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt). بلَغَتِ: a fatha over the lām (2.9 x 1.8 pt), a fatha over the dot of the ghayn (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a kasra under the tā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt). القَوْس: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the wāw (2.5 x 2.5 pt). اضْعَفْناها: a round sukun over the dot of the ḍād (2.2 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the ʿayn (2.9 x 1.4 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt). المَعْنَى: a fatha over the mīm (3.2 x 1.8 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.2 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the dot of the nūn (3.2 x 1.8 pt). والرَّصْد: over the rā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the ṣād (2.5 x 2.5 pt). عليه, نقطة, نصفه, وما, كان, واحد and بهذه have no signs.
